top_strength: Joanna gathered all essential discovery details (name, date, route, square footage, bedrooms, oversize items, fragile items, parking, garage contents) and asked about the customer's concerns upfront before diving into logistics.
coaching_note: Add the quid pro quo framing at the top ('10–15 minutes, you'll walk away with a quote you can depend on, does that sound good?'), skip the email send offer in Section 7 (it's a built-in out), and end with a genuine final concerns check—not just routing to email review without asking what's still worrying them about the move.
